name: icon_find
description: Find the icons that ship (Phosphor, MIT) by words: each word begins a word of an icon's name, its tags, or its categories, and its name asked whole comes first. Each icon is its path data on a view 256 square, which deck_patch's add_node adds as a shape: {"type": "shape", "path": …, "view": [0, 0, 256, 256], "fill": "accent"}, so icons beside each other keep one weight.

Weight.description: A weight an icon is drawn in.

oneOf.description: Drawn in outline, Phosphor's regular weight.

query.description:
The words to find: each begins a word of an icon's name, its tags, or its categories.
None finds every icon.

weight.description: `regular`, drawn in outline (the default), or `fill`, drawn solid.

limit.description: At most this many; 20 when not given.

Found.description: An icon found: its name, its tags and categories, and the icon to insert in the weight asked.

Icon.description: An icon to insert (PLAN 2.104): its name, its path data, and the view it is drawn on.

name.description: Its name in its set, in kebab case: `airplane-tilt`.

view.description: The box of the path's own coordinates it is drawn on, [x, y, w, h].
